run8a.diagnosis: Greedy 32-D residual codebooks reduce calibration residual monotonically but leave roughly one-third activation-weighted vector energy unexplained even after eight stages; end-to-end quality is unusable.

run8b.diagnosis: Four independent 8-D subspaces and per-layer/per-operator codebooks improve vector fit capacity but still produce catastrophic end-to-end perplexity. Naive Euclidean/diagonal-RMS VQ is rejected as the primary extreme-weight codec.

conclusion: Runs 6-8 jointly falsify uniform low-rank projection, post-hoc whole-block sharing, shared output bases, naive residual VQ, and naive residual product VQ on SmolLM2-135M. Next work must establish competitive Q4_K_M/Q2_K measured baselines and use second-order/rotation/outlier-aware extreme quantization or learned/distilled representations rather than ad-hoc PTQ geometry.
claim_boundary: No usable compressed SmolLM2 LARC candidate exists yet. Run 8 reports exact compressed-representation quality and modeled weight bytes on a custom evaluation slice; no Q4_K_M parity, standard benchmark, packed VQ kernel, or measured LARC RSS/VRAM is claimed.
